Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes Require an accepted child, successful completion, and its delivered result in the requester’s subsequent report before passing subagent-handoff QA. **Example:** sessions_spawn returns status "forbidden", and the requester reports "no child was created" under the expected labels. - **Before:** The scenario can pass from planned-spawn evidence and labeled prose. - **After:** The scenario fails because no accepted child run exists. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | The implementation is focused and source-consistent, but synthetic observations do not satisfy the repository’s required production-flow proof. | | **Proof confidence** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | Real behavior proof is not required for maintainer- or bot-authored pull requests. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Maintainers can receive a passing subagent-handoff result even though delegation was refused and no child ran. **Reason:** The change restores the scenario’s documented success contract without changing agent capabilities, permissions, or user configuration. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** This PR addresses a current QA false pass with a focused correction; source review found no concrete correctness or security defect. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `0222f7b1a7e0b03037ff3ad198340b6bc511703c` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None. ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: The registered scenario has not been shown completing through an isolated Gateway with an accepted child, successful settlement, and subsequent public requester report.
Agent review details ### How this fits together QA Lab runs the registered scenario through a Gateway, reads tool receipts and child completion, then joins public requester history to the internal settlement transcript to produce a pass or failure. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[QA scenario] --> B[Requester agent] B --> C[Accepted child run] C --> D[Terminal result] D --> E[Requester settlement] E --> F[Public requester report] F --> G[QA verdict] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep the correction in QA Lab, using existing receipt, completion, formatter, and transcript owners to establish the handoff. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main source permits the reported refused-spawn false pass, consistent with the linked synthetic reproduction; this read-only review executed no target code. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The fix addresses the scoring invariant directly, replaces the weaker predicate, and reuses production formatting rather than introducing another completion owner. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [4393498591bb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4393498591bbd3bbff3371e2821ae2305c0f19ea). ### Provenance checked - `Planned-spawn and prose-based scoring` keeps the original intent (b13844732e39996c4d32905efc0257445720d559: Prevent prose-only fabricated delegation and evidence borrowed from another scenario.) - `Scenario request isolation` keeps the original intent (6a8e11e63ceed04aed5476180b2a9a4dccea44a0: Scope diagnostic requests to the current scenario and establish causal evidence before accepting delivery.) - `Mock requester completion handling` keeps the original intent (d6b2ad33fd27baeaa0e7dd37928d83a3c13bbe0c: Wait for protected child completion rather than treating a spawn acceptance receipt as the result.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Current-main false-pass path:** Current main checks labeled requester prose and a planned sessions_spawn request, without requiring accepted admission or child completion. ([`qa/scenarios/agents/subagent-handoff.yaml:83`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/4393498591bbd3bbff3371e2821ae2305c0f19ea/qa/scenarios/agents/subagent-handoff.yaml#L83), [4393498591bb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4393498591bbd3bbff3371e2821ae2305c0f19ea)) - **Pinned introduced change:** The introduced diff replaces the old predicate with current-request admission, matching run completion, visible terminal output, and a settlement-linked requester report. ([`qa/scenarios/agents/subagent-handoff.yaml:54`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/0222f7b1a7e0b03037ff3ad198340b6bc511703c/qa/scenarios/agents/subagent-handoff.yaml#L54), [0222f7b1a7e0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0222f7b1a7e0b03037ff3ad198340b6bc511703c)) - **Production settlement contract:** The completion producer emits status and prompt-data-framed child results; the new reader uses that formatter and checks settlement provenance plus transcript ancestry. ([`src/agents/subagents/announce/subagent-announce-result.ts:191`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/0222f7b1a7e0b03037ff3ad198340b6bc511703c/src/agents/subagents/announce/subagent-announce-result.ts#L191), [0222f7b1a7e0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0222f7b1a7e0b03037ff3ad198340b6bc511703c)) - **Private QA facade:** qa-runtime is explicitly private and excluded from published package artifacts; the formatter re-export does not expand the public plugin API. ([`scripts/lib/plugin-sdk-private-local-only-subpaths.json:161`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/0222f7b1a7e0b03037ff3ad198340b6bc511703c/scripts/lib/plugin-sdk-private-local-only-subpaths.json#L161), [0222f7b1a7e0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0222f7b1a7e0b03037ff3ad198340b6bc511703c)) - **Linked reproduction and supplied validation:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176098 reports a synthetic refused-spawn false pass; this PR explicitly describes evaluator and mocked-observation validation without a live provider. - **Original anti-fabrication intent:** The historical parity repair sought to prevent fabricated delegation and cross-scenario evidence; the replacement strengthens that intent by using a unique requester session and actual receipts. ([`qa/scenarios/agents/subagent-handoff.md`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/b13844732e39996c4d32905efc0257445720d559/qa/scenarios/agents/subagent-handoff.md), [b13844732e39](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b13844732e39996c4d32905efc0257445720d559)) Likely related people: - **Josh Avant:** Raw commit 1a0e022cb1e271024fe90a2d70d6d529f89dfd68 adds extensions/qa-lab/src/suite-runtime-agent-session.ts:535 relative to its recorded parents.
